comment: A light noise stroke keeps its holes under a pen that wobbles or rests. Grain Round at 0.1 of the short side, a radius of 70 pixels, at a pressure of 0.12 throughout, black on a white 1000 by 700 document, every stroke on one layer. Top left a clean straight line with a sample every pixel, under it the same line with each sample moved across it by up to 0.8 pixels, top right a pen held for 300 samples within 0.8 pixels of one spot, under it a single tap, and along the bottom a wobbling line that rests for 300 samples and leaves turned down by 45 degrees, a recorded stroke. Then a second document of four wobbling lines that rest, 40 samples within 0.5 pixels for the upper two and 120 for the lower two, then leave turned down by 45 degrees, two of the rests inside a chunk and two on a corner of the 256 pixel chunk grid, for whether the straight seams a painter saw at a rest are the chunks'. One look of the colour each. Nothing is saved.
